name: tiktok_creator_marketplace-mcp
description: TikTok One (Creator Marketplace) (ads): me, list_campaigns. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

platform_mcp_tiktok_creator_marketplace_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CREATOR_MARKETPLACE_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_tiktok_creator_marketplace_.description: Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account (auth_code exchanged at /oauth2/access_token/); it does not expire unless the account revokes it (https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).

platform_mcp_tiktok_creator_marketplace_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CREATOR_MARKETPLACE_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_tiktok_creator_marketplace_.description: Secret of your TikTok for Business developer app, needed by the account-listing call used by me.

platform_mcp_tiktok_creator_marketplace_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CREATOR_MARKETPLACE_APP_ID
platform_mcp_tiktok_creator_marketplace_.description: App ID of your TikTok for Business developer app (My Apps > App Detail > Basic Information).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /tto/oauth2/tcm/?app_id&secret: {data: {tto_tcm_account_ids: [...]}}, the TTO Creator Marketplace accounts that authorised the app (use one as account_id).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /tto/tcm/campaign/?tto_tcm_account_id={account_id} (page_size at most 5). These are creator-collaboration campaigns (brand, creators invited, video ids), not paid ad campaigns: there is no budget or delivery status.
